scenarios.scenario: Open and close an empty browser search in a part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser is visible with no search field open
the user opens browser search
an empty search field appears beneath the browser header
the field shows the placeholder "Type Keyword"
the browser tree and solid remain visible
the user closes the empty search field
the search field is hidden
the browser tree and solid remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Search the Model tree from another active dock tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-points.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Model and Log occupy one dock tab bar with Log active
the Model search field is closed
the user clicks the search icon in that dock tab bar
Model becomes active and its empty search field has keyboard focus
the Find criteria dialog remains closed
the user types "InspectionPoint" without clicking another control
the Model tree shows InspectionPointA, InspectionPointB and InspectionPointC
the query is highlighted in the matching tree rows
the user switches to Log and clicks the dock tab bar search icon again
Model becomes active with "InspectionPoint" still in the focused search field

scenarios.scenario: Collapse and expands model browser branches

the user opens the model browser menu
the user chooses Collapse All
the expanded branches collapse to their parent rows

the user opens the model browser menu
the user chooses Expand All
nested browser rows are displayed
the model remains displayed in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Collapse and expands a feature branch

scenarios.scenario: Filter model browser entries by name

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-points.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with multiple work points and other features
the model browser is visible
the user opens the browser search field
the user enters "InspectionPoint"
InspectionPointA, InspectionPointB and InspectionPointC are shown in the browser
the matching text is highlighted in those rows
unrelated visible feature rows are filtered from the browser
the model remains displayed in the viewport
the user activates the search field close control
the search text is cleared
the unfiltered browser tree is shown again
the user activates the close control again
the browser search field is hidden

scenarios.scenario: Show an empty browser search result

the search query remains visible in the field
the model remains displayed in the viewport

the unfiltered model browser tree is shown again

scenarios.scenario: Float and redock the drawing browser

the browser floats over the drawing sheet
the browser displays drawing resources and the sheet tree
the drawing remains visible behind the browser
the user drags the floating browser header to the left edge of the workspace
the browser docks at the left edge
the drawing remains visible in the remaining workspace

scenarios.scenario: Add and switch between browser panel tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is active in the MCAD Software
its Model browser is docked on the left

the log panel becomes active in the same dock
the Model browser remains available as a tab
the user selects the Model browser tab
the drawing resources and sheet tree are displayed
the user selects the log panel tab
the log area is displayed in the dock
the user closes the log panel tab
the Model browser is displayed
the drawing remains visible
